title: S61 — Verify: clean-clone product smoke + latency receipt (typer + demo, current main)
desc: NEW-OP STARTER. GOAL: prove the product path works on current main exactly as a stranger experiences it: follow README.md on a clean clone (typer + browser demo + bench smoke) and re-measure the ≤10 s latency claim with the committed latency tool. WHY: the bar includes 'image → text ≤10 s' and 'reproducible from a clean clone'; both must be re-proven after merges. STEPS: clean clone → README steps → every documented command; capture every deviation; latency probe across the committed probe set; note machine specs. EVIDENCE: reports/clean-smoke/<date>.md + latency json + PUSHES row + formalcode line. BOUNDARIES: README command/typo errors → fix in a docs PR; product-code problems → file a bug task, do not fix here. Boundaries: no edits to shipping paths unless the task says so; no tuning on canonical seeds 1/2/3/4/53 (evaluation only); honest numbers — no 98/95 claims; captchaproject(s) off-limits.
